# License status

The upstream `hennequin-lab/optimal-preparation` repository did not contain a
software license file or an explicit software-license declaration when it was
audited at commit `40077d2da16e68ab2ab2cff59ec692b97315980b`.

Consequently, this repository tracks attribution, pinned identifiers,
checksums, and local acquisition/verification scripts only. It does not track
or redistribute the upstream source, the generated native numerical export,
the paper PDF, or `opam.exe`. Those materials may exist only in the ignored
`local_cache/` for authorized local scientific use.

The associated paper is distributed under CC BY 4.0; that publication license
must not be interpreted as a software-license grant for the upstream code.
